findings.fix_hint: Either add `button.menu` translation to lang/fr.json + lang/en.json, or replace the `aria-label="$t('button.menu')"` binding (likely in resources/js/views/pos/PosShell.vue or PosNavbar) with a literal/already-resolved translation. findings.evidence: POS render emits Vue warning: `[Vue warn]: Property "itemsRaw" was accessed during render but is not defined on instance. at <PosComponent onVnodeUnmounted=fn<onVnodeUnmounted> ref=Ref< undefined > > at <RouterView> at <DefaultComponent> at <App>`. Present on 3 POS states (01, 04, 07). This is a render-time accessor on undefined data — symptom of either (a) a template binding referencing a removed/renamed data property, or (b) a race where the template renders before the async catalog fetch resolves. Not user-blocking but indicates fragile reactivity.
findings.fix_hint: Find the `itemsRaw` reference in PosComponent.vue (or its template/computed). Either declare it in `data()` / `setup()` with a sane default (`itemsRaw: []`), or rename it to match the actual store getter (likely `pos/itemsRaw` Vuex namespace). Add a defensive `v-if` guard around the binding.
